facts.text: Report Production Outage action creates a support ticket for Microsoft when users cannot sign in to production environments.
Select the relevant environment in admin center and choose Support > Report Production Outage.
Choose outage type: Unable to sign in (all users) or Can't access API/Web Service.
Provide your name, email, phone number, and details about the outage including browsers, errors, and correlation IDs.
Add the date and time when the outage began and provide consent before reporting.
Report Production Outage option is not available for sandbox environments.
After reporting, view the support ticket ID in the dialog and track progress via the Reported Outages page.
